name: design-screenshots
description: Read-only walk that captures every published screen at desktop (1440) and phone (390) width for the design critique, and fails on clipped or overlapping text at both widths (the captures are kept either way). Replace the click targets with your app's navigation names; add one block per screen. Captures land in the driver's output folder as <name>.png plus an aria snapshot.
